message: 天使の歌声

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, over here!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The vice president's still gettin' ready, so you'll be sittin' with us.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really know how things work around here, so that's a big help.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Thank you for having me today!」

name: Ria
message: 「No need to be so nervous. Just relax, relax♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oho~~ So this is how everyone gathers every week.」
Today is Sunday--
I brought Amyrina along to coincide with the time when the academy grounds are open to the public.
Speaking of Sunday, worship service is held at the church.
And that's apparently where the choir practices.
Having been invited by Misa, even those of us who don't normally attend service ended up joining in.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, shall we go?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y... Yes!」
With nervousness and curiosity mixed together, Amyrina seemed more restless than usual.

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, welcome. How rare for you to come to service.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa invited us along.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're just a bonus. Amyrina-san is the real guest.」

name: Misa
message: 「If you'd like, please sing along with us when it's time for the hymns, okay?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes...」

name: Misa
message: 「See you later, then. Maybe after it's over♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Aha, so Amyrina-chan was the choir helper she was talking about.」

name: Synn
message: 「You already heard about it?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. She asked me if they could practice on regular weekdays too.」

name: Synn
message: 「She moves fast... She must really want to recruit Amyrina.」

name: Helena
message: 「Though, I'm sorry. We haven't really made exceptions like that before.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-No... It's nothing really」
The pipe organ begins to play, signaling the start of the service.
The congregation stands up in unison, and the priest recites the call to worship.
And next, we sing a hymn.
Together with Amyrina beside me, I opened the lyric sheet I borrowed from Misa to the right page.
I glance over at Misa standing in the choir row.
A slight wink, and then--

name: Amyrina
message: 「Whoa...」
A neatly harmonized four-part mixed chorus echoes throughout the chapel.
Faced with that sound, Amyrina forgot to sing and listened in rapt fascination.
Because it is a doxology hymn, it ends briefly, and prayer begins.
Chattering is strictly forbidden during the service. I look at Amyrina's expression to check how she's doing.
Her eyes are still sparkling.
I wonder if this has been a good influence on her.
Even if she doesn't go so far as singing in front of this many people, I brought her here hoping she'd become even more interested in singing.
The unexpected happened when it came time to sing the next hymn.
Matching the choir's song, Amyrina let her singing voice ring out loud and clear.

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing...」
Perhaps some things stand out precisely because it's a sacred place.
Literally an Angel's Bless--.
Captivated by that voice, the congregation stopped singing and listened intently.
Without paying any mind to their reaction, Amyrina sings freely and effortlessly along with the accompaniment and the choir's chorus.
With each passing day, every time she learns a new song. The true worth of her singing talent becomes clearer.
--And so, time passed in the blink of an eye, and the service ended with the final benediction.
After the postlude, we let out a big sigh.

name: Helena
message: 「Wonderful!」
Triggered by Helena-san's applause, a standing ovation broke out inside the chapel.

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eh, eh...」
Amyrina alone looked as though she had no idea what had just happened.

name: Synn
message: 「During the hymns in the service, everyone was completely captivated by your singing, Amyrina」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eh... N-No way...\s03」

name: Helena
message: 「I see. It certainly makes sense why Misa-chan has been recommending her so much」

name: Misa
message: 「Right! That's why I really want you to let her join choir practice!」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's see... Rather than making a special exception, there's an easier and faster way for you to join the choir」

name: Helena
message: 「To put it bluntly, you transfer in!!」
